R12 correctness review complete. 0 CRIT. 3 MAJ: (1) SB-001 fix test gap — admin/required-checks CAUTION log lines appended to RESTORE_CAUTION_LINES at lines 864/873 but ack tests at 2486/2594 only assert 'verification passed ✓', not the CAUTION text; force_pushes/deletions ack tests (2543/2546) DO assert CAUTION lines — inconsistency means SB-001 regression is untested. (2) Forward-mode ACK_RESTORE_* flags silently accepted — no guard at lines 277-296 rejects any of the 5 restore-ack flags when RESTORE_MODE=0; CORR2-003 correctly rejects ACK_ADMIN_BYPASS without --no-enforce-admins but no symmetric guard exists for restore-ack flags without --restore. (3) No test for forward-mode restore-flag behavior — no run_enable_case or run_enable_case_at_cwd call passes any --i-understand-restore-* flag. 4 MIN: (4) R11-CORR-MIN-001 carry-forward: .github/workflows/check-invocation-log-entry.yml:31 still shows '# v6.0.2' for SHA de0fac2e; no v6 release exists for actions/checkout. (5) R11-CORR-MIN-002 carry-forward: no test combines enforce_admins:false + allow_force_pushes:true in one pre-state.json. (6) R11-CORR-MIN-003 carry-forward: ADOPT-001 §12.8 Gate 1 command at line 1200 shows --restore <pre-state.json> with no posture-ack flags; operator finds exit 2 mid-incident. (7) Cohort elevation regex 024[C-F] at workflow line 59 misses future sub-slices/cohorts beyond F. 2 nit: (8) Dead pre-build RESTORE_CAUTION_LINES_BLOCK at lines 833-835 builds an incomplete block (missing admin/required-checks entries added at 863-875) and is overwritten at 939-944; (9) Substring verify for contexts at line 990 uses grep -F allowing live superset to pass silently.
